comparison.objective: Install one load-bearing rack rail versus load four connector modules and click a hinged frame shut.
comparison.physical_skill: Long-part support, separated-post alignment, spring-prong insertion and fastening versus repeated module seating followed by frame closure.
comparison.success_condition: Front/rear prongs, rack-unit leveling, spring extension and prescribed screws versus four modules seated in windows and the frame clicked shut.
comparison.reason: Both involve insertion and latching, but the candidate tests staged retention across distant posts, telescoping and fastening rather than multi-part packing into one frame. Candidate force limits are missing.
